subject: Pilot scope: EU/APAC multilingual quality pilot — next steps
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Anna Müller <anna.mueller@finova.de>, Kenji Sato <k.sato@korepay.jp>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 10 Apr 2029 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Pilot scope: EU/APAC multilingual quality pilot — next steps

Hi Anna / Kenji,

Thanks again for the call this morning — great context on the EU payments chat flows and the APAC multi-lingual routing piece. Quick recap and a suggested next step so we keep momentum: 

Summary of needs we heard:
- EU languages: DE, FR, NL; strong need for formality control and regulatory-safe responses (KYC disclaimers).
- APAC languages: JP, KO, and a small SEA subset (EN/CMN localizations). Low-latency requirement for chat (P95 < 450ms).
- Quality bar: human-like accuracy on entity extraction and translation fidelity for regulatory text (bench target: >92% EM on our locale prompts).

Redwood recommendations (initial candidate models):
- rw-clarion-7b-q4 (int8) — low-latency candidate for interactive chat (good for JP/KO with custom prompts).
- rw-neptune-13b-ft-multilingual — stronger generation/translation quality for DE/FR/NL and regulatory phrasing; slightly higher cost but better for critical responses.
- mosaic-13b-ml (open) — a lower-cost fallback for high-volume embedding/slot-filling pipelines.

What we propose for a pilot (2-week scope):
1) Pilot slices: 3 locales (DE, FR, JP), 5000 inference tokens/day average; synthetic and live-sampled traffic.
2) Evaluation: we will run our benchmark suite (attached CSV) with your sample prompts + our prompt pack (attached) and return per-prompt accuracy, BLEU-like scores, and hallucination flags.
3) Monitoring & regressions: Redwood Optimize will run regression detection against the provided baseline prompt set and will trigger a weekly quality digest. We'll also instrument token-level latency traces so we can tune batching without breaking the latency SLO.
4) Security/compliance: standard SCQ & evidence; we can start with our public SOC2 packet and then run the customer questionnaire you mentioned.

Attachments and links: pilot_prompt_pack_v2.zip (prompt templates + rubric), locale_benchmarks_eu_apac.csv (baseline test corpus), data_sample_anon.jsonl (example format). Full bench results and a short readout will be shared in a week after we ingest the sample. Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3cEUAPAC-benchmarks. HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/7891.

Next steps / asks for you:
- Can you share a 1-week sample of anonymized chat logs (same format as data_sample_anon.jsonl) by EOD Friday?
- Confirm target locales (if you want NL included) and expected steady-state throughput.
- If you're comfortable, we'll prepare a one-page mutual action plan + NDA to start ingestion.

I’ll loop in Neha (solutions) and Marissa (CS) in follow-ups to scope the configuration and support.

Thanks — Karthik

--
Karthik Iyer
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0128

2) Benchmarks: the CSV looks good; will your scoring include a per-locale confusion matrix so we can see systematic degradations?
3) Data sharing: we can provide the anonymized chat week, but legal wants NDA first.

Also, for APAC we plan to include a small pilot in JP only for now; Korea is still under discussion internally. If the pilot looks good we'll expand.

Best,
Anna

Thanks Anna — quick answers inline and a concrete plan for tomorrow's sync: 

> Latency: for EU (DE/FR) our target is P95 <= 450ms when hosted in Frankfurt. Can you confirm the clarion-7b int8 path meets this on your Dedicated racks?

Yes — on our Dedicated Frankfurt pools with the int8 path we observe ~380–420ms P95 for 1–2 concurrent user streams at the sequence lengths you described (avg 80 tokens). We'll include a short latency profile in the bench results. If you prefer lower P95 we can run the rw-clarion with a reduced KV cache strategy to shave ~20–30ms at some cost.

> Benchmarks: the CSV looks good; will your scoring include a per-locale confusion matrix so we can see systematic degradations?

Yes — we'll produce per-locale confusion matrices, precision/recall on entity extraction, and hallucination flags per prompt. Expect the first pass within 5 business days after we ingest the sample.

> Data sharing: we can provide the anonymized chat week, but legal wants NDA first.

Understood. I'll attach a one-page mutual action plan + standard NDA in the follow-up doc we send after this thread. For now I've attached the pilot prompt pack and the benchmark CSV so you can preview the rubric.

Proposed sync: Thu 11 Apr 2029 at 09:00 CEST / 03:00 EDT — if that matches your calendar we'll send an invite. Agenda: 20m pilot scope, 20m measurement & acceptance criteria, 10m security/compliance ask.

Internal note for Neha / Marissa:
- Neha: can you confirm we can provision a Frankfurt dedicated pool scoped to this pilot (3 locales, 5k tokens/day) and a short rollback policy (canary to mosaic fallback)?
- Marissa: if pilot progresses, can you prepare a CS onboarding checklist for a 2-week trial (support SLAs, escalation path)?

Attaching: pilot_prompt_pack_v2.zip, locale_benchmarks_eu_apac.csv. Full evidence packet will follow.

Cheers,
Karthik

> Proposed sync: Thu 11 Apr 2029 at 09:00 CEST / 03:00 EDT — if that matches your calendar we'll send an invite. Agenda: 20m pilot scope, 20m measurement & acceptance criteria, 10m security/compliance ask.

Thanks Karthik — confirmed on provisioning. Quick operational checklist for the pilot: 

- Provisioning: Frankfurt dedicated pool (1x conv shard, 1x batch shard) — will be live within 24 hours after we get the anonymized sample.
- Observability: we will enable token-level traces, per-request latency and model-version tagging. We'll add a weekly regression report and a Slack alert when a locale drops >3% absolute on the acceptance metric.
- QA plan: we will run the attached benchmark over your sample and generate per-prompt pass/fail with recommended prompt edits (we'll include sample rewrites in the prompt pack).
- Security: please send the legal contact for the NDA; we will also send the security questionnaire link (OneTrust) and a short SOC2 evidence packet.

Proposed kickoff invite times (Anna): 09:00 CEST / Thu works for our team. I'll send the invite and include a brief runbook.
